 © 2026 Yahoo. All rights reserved. Derek Mason and Middle Tennessee State football will try to keep their Conference USA championship game hopes alive when the Blue Raiders travel to league co-leader Liberty on Nov. 14 (2:30 p.m. CT, CBS Sports Network).
 A win would also give MTSU bowl eligibility.
 Advertisement Advertisement Advertisement The Blue Raiders (5-4, 3-2 CUSA) are coming off a 51-42 triumph over rival Western Kentucky . Liberty (8-1, 5-0) has won eight in a row, including a 30-14 win over New Mexico State on Nov. 7.
 Follow below for live updates, scores, TV information and odds:
